limits: This is independent evidence reconciliation, not independent runtime reproduction or proof of whole-language safety.
48 invalid programs yield 96 refused Rust process records under two budgets; they are not 96 distinct invalid programs.
Native failure-policy cases include successful returns and fatal traps; live allocations at a trap are retained honestly, not relabeled as successful cleanup.
The native ledger observes allocation/free/live bytes and scalar results, not runtime loan lifetimes.
Some native run/build argv are recoverable from bound fixture source and arguments rather than separately repeated in each process record; this audit does not invent missing original argv fields.
Original resource-source bae reports and frozen NDU studies are separate and were not changed or relabeled.
scope: Independent read-only audit of frozen bytes, source bindings, command transcripts and denominators; no interpreter/native/build re-execution
